context: Civic news: Sakura and Ren on a law revision.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: civic news; vocabulary (改正/規定/特定/活用/手段) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日、法律の改正が決まりました。
lines.en: A law revision was decided today.
lines.style: crisp adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新しい規定は、何を定めますか?
lines.en: What do the new provisions stipulate?
lines.style: measured young commentator voice, soft warm analytical calm throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 特定の業種に、規定が加わります。
lines.en: Provisions are added for specific industries.
lines.style: clear adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 改正の目的は、何でしょう?
lines.en: What's the aim of the revision?
lines.style: curious young commentator voice, soft warm analytical calm throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 資源を有効に活用することが目的です。
lines.en: The aim is to use resources effectively.
lines.style: professional adult anchor voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: どんな手段で、進めるんですか?
lines.en: By what means will they advance it?
lines.style: analytical young commentator voice, soft warm calm throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 段階的な手段で、規定を広げます。
lines.en: By gradual means, they'll expand the provisions.
lines.style: measured adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 改正を、うまく活用したいですね。
lines.en: I hope they use the revision well.
lines.style: earnest young commentator voice, soft warm calm closing throughout
